_meta.description: Reference taxonomy of tags this app recognizes, grouped by the entity type they can be attached to. Declarative reference, but the color field IS live — src/lib/tag.ts reads it directly to style chips, so this file is the single place a tag's color gets decided (see "color" below; CSS itself still lives in globals.css, this just says which tag uses which one). An actual tag assignment on an entity is expected to be a flat array of these tag keys (e.g. a track's tags: string[]), not a typed value. New tags get added here only once a real use case surfaces; don't pre-populate speculative ones.
_meta.conventions: All fields below are optional and default to "unset"/false when omitted — omit rather than writing out false/empty explicitly (e.g. {"name": "Mastering"} with nothing else is normal, not incomplete).

fields.name: Human-readable display label. Falls back to the tag key itself if omitted.
fields.description: What this tag means and when to apply it, including where it came from. Omit if the name is self-explanatory.
fields.display_inherit_up: If true, this tag should also be visually surfaced on the entity's parent(s) when displayed (e.g. a track tag showing through on its song). Omitted = false.
fields.display_inherit_down: If true, this tag should also be visually surfaced on the entity's children when displayed (e.g. a song tag showing through on all its tracks). Omitted = false.
fields.color: Optional palette name matching a .tag-<color>/.tag-<color>-bg pair already defined in src/app/globals.css (e.g. "sky", "indigo", "emerald"). Multiple tags can share one color. Omitted = the neutral default chip style — most tags should stay uncolored until there's a real reason to pull the eye to them.

learning.name: Learning
learning.description: A track group assembled as a practice/teaching packet for the band (e.g. isolated stems + a reference demo) rather than a release or rough-cuts drop.

learning.name: Learning
learning.description: A deliberately bare-bones version of a part (e.g. an isolated instrument track, often paired with a chord chart) meant to help a band member learn their part — not a polished reference mix. Surfaced from the Magi-cali rhythm-guitar upload, 2026-09-27. Purely informational: a learning-tagged track can sit in any track group (including a non-learning one), and a learning track group can still contain an untagged full demo mix alongside it — no rules attached to this tag.

master.name: Master
master.description: This version is the mastered/final production of the track, distinct from a rough mix or demo. Should surface on the parent song when displayed (e.g. "this song has a master") — that's what display_inherit_up covers, no separate song-level tag needed.
